title: Calf stretch at the wall

steps.text: Stand facing a wall with both hands on it at chest height.
steps.cue: Face the wall, hands at chest height.

steps.text: Step one foot back and press that heel toward the floor. Keep the back leg straight.
steps.cue: One foot back. Heel down, leg straight.

steps.text: Bend the front knee until you feel a gentle stretch in the back calf.
steps.cue: Bend the front knee. Gentle stretch.

steps.text: Hold still and breathe slowly, then change legs.

mistakes: Letting the back heel lift or the back foot turn out.
regression: Take a shorter step back so the stretch is lighter.
stopIf: Stop if you feel sharp pain in your calf, heel or ankle.

anatomy.why: Keeping the back heel down with a straight knee lengthens the calf.
